class_rule: charades.choose_classes(selected rows, n_classes=25, min_segments=50); class ids are the literal 'cXYZ' strings from Charades_v1_train.csv actions column. The library default min_segments=60 leaves only 19 classes on this 700-video subset, so the threshold was lowered until 25 classes qualified
selection_rule: from the 700 charades.load_rows() clips: charades.build_plan(rows, n_videos=700) = even stride over the lexicographically sorted official-train ids (idx_i=floor(i*N/n)), split 70/15/15 by contiguous blocks of that sorted selection; the split unit is the video id, never a frame
sampling_rule: decode every frame once; for t_k = linspace(0, length-1e-3, 96) take the decoded frame whose PTS is nearest t_k (streaming nearest-time mapping; targets past the last frame clamp to it)
timestamp_rule: t = np.linspace(0, csv_length - 1e-3, 96) float32 seconds, strictly increasing; csv_length from Charades_v1_train.csv
label_rule: charades.frame_labels(t, row['_segs'], classes): event[T,C] uint8 = 1 iff t in [onset, offset) of that class; onset[T] uint8 = 1 iff any segment starts in (t_{k-1}, t_k]
class_source: top-10 by segment count from charades_pixel
